tldr: Chiron transiting the 11th house: a long healing chapter around friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures.
body: Chiron moving through the 11th house can reopen old material around friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is in groups and belonging; friendships, communities, or hopes have hurt.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures. You become the one who makes room for the outsiders.
shadow: Withdrawing from community, or chasing a belonging that costs you.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 11th house deliberately. Work with friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
